verdict.rationale: Cline can run long tasks without supervision: headless CLI with auto-approve, runs inside GitHub Actions, GitLab or any pipeline, and scheduled agents that persist across restarts and run independently of any terminal session. Kanban adds isolated git worktrees for parallel agents. However, these are local or self-provisioned CI setups, and there is no evidence of a first-party managed cloud sandbox for delegated background tasks. Missing for 10: vendor-hosted isolated cloud execution environment, a built-in cloud task delegation and monitoring workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of background cloud runs.
